@healthygamer_gg, popularly known as Dr. K, is a psychiatrist, author, and President of Healthy Gamer.

He is known for combining psychiatry, neuroscience, and practical psychology to help people better understand mental health, relationships, motivation, and emotional well-being.

Through his conversations and educational content, he has become one of the world’s most influential voices on modern mental health.

In Today’s Episode, He Talks About The Parenting Change Every Mom Faces
